name: inneros-vantage-qlink
description: Local, read-only Vantage QLink field MCP adapter for the InnerOS canonical repository.

interface.longDescription: Read-only USB/RS-232 diagnostics and QLink backup inventory on an onsite technician laptop. Does not control relays, modify configuration, or expose Home Assistant entities.
interface.defaultPrompt: Revisa los puertos RS-232 del Vantage QLink local y captura una sesión de diagnóstico sin modificar el controlador.
